scientific_integrity: All-order proof by forced-edge contraction and BEST correspondence, finite exact-check programs embedded; no claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Binary factors of weight at most two only; orientation retained, rotation quotiented; no count for higher bounds or exact-weight-two-only words. Known existence and general arborescence machinery credited to previous work; equivalent unindexed prior enumeration remains possible.
title: A Boolean-cube enumeration of binary weight-at-most-two universal cycles
